notes: The upscaler draws a frame before it takes the picture over, so turning HD+ on lands the sharpen on the frame you are looking at - paused or playing - instead of covering the stage with a canvas that had nothing in it.
Every size in the quality list can be picked again: choosing one clears what the tab had learned against it for this film and plays that exact size, instead of quietly landing on a different one.

The music video is in the song menu as well as on the rail, and the rail has its own three dots: the same song actions sheet opens from the side of the screen, with fewer dividers and one size for every glyph.
